praises: 16-inch 3K AMOLED 120Hz touch with 32GB RAM — the closest thing to a MacBook Pro 16 alternative in Samsung's range
32GB LPDDR5X finally matches the 'Pro' label for heavy multitasking and light creative work
Still ~1.6 kg for a 16-inch — far lighter than typical 16-inch laptops
Thunderbolt 4, Wi-Fi 7, Copilot+ NPU, microSD reader
Galaxy phone + S Pen integration on a big touch canvas
complaints: $3,599.99 flat with no discount while the 14" Pro sells for half that — brutal pricing
iGPU only: at $3,600 competitors offer discrete RTX GPUs
32GB soldered — pay for it up front, never upgrade
Glossy AMOLED mirror effect in bright rooms
Samsung bloatware and a thinner CA service network than Dell/Lenovo at this price

design_philosophy: The Book6 Pro 16 is the line's flagship: the biggest Dynamic AMOLED 2x panel Samsung puts in a laptop, 32GB RAM, and Thunderbolt 4 in a 1.6 kg 16-inch chassis. It deliberately trades GPU muscle for display and portability — a mobile-office/consumption flagship rather than a creator workstation — and at full $3,599 list it is priced where RTX-equipped rivals crowd in.
rating_notes: Inferred from Book6 Pro 14 (+2 screen_size, +1 productivity for 32GB, −1 battery for larger AMOLED, −1.5 portability at ~1.6 kg). Dealbreakers: full-price $3,599 with iGPU only. Bot-wall disclosure in SHARED-galaxy-book.md. Image URL best-guess BBY CDN pattern.
